#include <stddef.h>
#if defined(__APPLE__)
#include <OpenGL/gl.h>
#include <OpenGL/glu.h>

#else
#define GL_GLEXT_PROTOTYPES
#include <GL/gl.h>
#include <GL/glext.h>
#include <GL/glu.h>
#include <GL/freeglut.h>
#endif
#include <math.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif

static float g_angle = 0.0f;
static int   g_rotating = 0;

--- gl_vector_helpers ---
/* C89 replacements for C99 compound GL literals. */

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat3(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat3_buf[3];
  repl_glfloat3_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[2] = c;
  return repl_glfloat3_buf;
}

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat4(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c, GLfloat d) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat4_buf[4];
  repl_glfloat4_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[2] = c;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[3] = d;
  return repl_glfloat4_buf;
}
--- display_header ---
void display(void) {
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
--- lights_pre_camera ---
--- camera ---
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -6.0000f);   // @camera dist
  glRotatef(5.0000f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);   // @camera rx
  glRotatef(32.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);   // @camera ry
  glTranslatef(-0.0000f, -0.9000f, -0.5000f);   // @camera pan
--- header_post ---
  float A[16], B[16], C[16];
--- source ---
  static float bladeCount = 135; // @tune
  static float field = 3.65; // half-width @tune
  static float x, z, h, w, angle, phase, flex;

  // Seed-slot convention: the caller (below) owns rand slots 0-6 for a
  // blade's placement/size/angle/phase/flex; blade() uses slots 11+ for
  // its own jitter/tint so the two RNG streams stay independent. (rand2
  // is just 2*rand-1, so a shared slot would correlate flex with jitter.)
  // Every value blade() derives is a function-scoped local: plain `float`
  // inside the body, one fresh set per call, no variable-panel slot.
  blade(seed, x0, z0, height, width, ang, ph, stiffness) {
    float wind, wave, bend, u, cx, cz, halfW, shade;
    wind = 0.55 + 0.25*sin(t*0.23);
    wave = sin(t*2.2 + ph + x0*0.35 + z0*0.20) + 0.35*sin(t*4.9 + ph*1.7);
    bend = (0.65 + 0.35*sin(t*0.75))*wave*stiffness*height*0.26;
    glBegin(GL_TRIANGLE_STRIP);
      for(s, 0, 6) {
        u = s/4;
        cx = x0 + 0.08*rand2(seed, 11)*u + cos(wind)*bend*u*u;
        cz = z0 + 0.08*rand2(seed, 12)*u + sin(wind)*bend*u*u;
        halfW = width*(1 - 0.82*u);
        shade = 0.65 + 0.45*u;
        glColor4f((0.08 + 0.07*rand(seed, 13))*shade, (0.38 + 0.32*rand(seed, 14))*shade, (0.06 + 0.07*rand(seed, 15))*shade, 0.95);
        glVertex3f(cx - cos(ang)*halfW, height*u, cz - sin(ang)*halfW);
        glVertex3f(cx + cos(ang)*halfW, height*u, cz + sin(ang)*halfW);
      }
    glEnd();
  }

  glClearColor(0.025, 0.055, 0.035, 1);
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  glEnable(GL_COLOR_MATERIAL);
  glColorMaterial(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_AMBIENT_AND_DIFFUSE);
  glLightModeli(GL_LIGHT_MODEL_TWO_SIDE, GL_TRUE);
  glMaterialfv(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SPECULAR, (GLfloat[]){0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 1});
  glMaterialf(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SHININESS, 30);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glDisable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glDisable(GL_CULL_FACE);
  glEnable(GL_BLEND);
  glBlendFunc(GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);
  for(p, 0, bladeCount) {
    x = (rand(p, 0)*2 - 1)*field;
    z = (rand(p, 1)*2 - 1)*field;
    h = 0.28 + rand(p, 2)*0.72;
    w = 0.018 + rand(p, 3)*0.026;
    angle = rand(p, 4)*TAU;
    phase = rand(p, 5)*TAU;
    flex = 0.55 + rand(p, 6)*1.1;
    blade(p, x, z, h, w, angle, phase, flex);
  }
  glDisable(GL_BLEND);
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
